description: Source code for the StreamingLinearRegressionWithSGD class in Apache Spark's MLlib, implementing streaming linear regression with stochastic gradient descent.

classes.name: StreamingLinearRegressionWithSGD
classes.description: A class for performing streaming linear regression using stochastic gradient descent, with configurable parameters such as step size, number of iterations, regularization, and mini-batch fraction.

methods.name: setStepSize
methods.description: Sets the step size for gradient descent.

methods.name: setNumIterations
methods.description: Sets the number of gradient descent iterations per update.

methods.name: setMiniBatchFraction
methods.description: Sets the fraction of each batch used for updates.

methods.name: setInitialWeights
methods.description: Sets the initial weights for the regression model.

methods.name: setConvergenceTol
methods.description: Sets the convergence tolerance for the optimizer.
